summary: Read all 14 members whole or in the relevant parts, plus the targets that exist (and the Philosopher Visits, Modes of Collaboration Context, Dialectic, Deleuze, Simondon, Trickster, Mermaid and quiz pages for evidence). 38 weak links: 21 labelled, 7 retyped, 10 cut, none kept as-is (all were bare). Pattern: where a page had a sentence naming the target, a label names the register (mostly origin, planned-build, or shared-mechanism); the three Philosophical Lens visits (Mathieu, LPC, Wavetable) and Ohm's Law's named-example status are really exemplifies of a mode; the Compressor-to-Boundary-Crossing link is the origin instance. Cuts are links where neither page names the other, the Ableton Extension SDK link (no page exists), and the Kuramoto parent links to its two quiz children (the children already carry child-of). Several pairs are reciprocal and bare (Harmonicity/Compressor/Hyperdimensional Prism, Modes of Collaboration/Ohm's Law, Trickster/Hyperdimensional Prism, Biomechanical Synthesis/Portamento); I flagged the other side where the pair should carry one link, but those reciprocal links are outside my list. Murmuration to Diversity of Thought is the weakest label I kept (low confidence). No genuine inbound links to the newcomer entries came from these pages, so typed_relations is empty.
